insights.title: 44% of trades die within 2 bars
insights.detail: 476/1087 trades exit via STOP_LOSS or FAIL_FAST within 2 bars. These are entries that immediately move against the position.

insights.title: MAE/MFE data not available — bar-by-bar tracking needed
insights.detail: trace_json stores entry-time features only, not intra-trade bar tracking. Adding MAE/MFE would enable stop optimization (are stops too tight? too loose?) and target calibration. Implementation: ~30 lines in opportunity_simulator.py:611-676.

insights.title: Top positive correlate with pnl_net: score.htf_confluence
insights.detail: score.htf_confluence has rho=0.235 (p=0.006678, N=132) with pnl_net. Higher values predict better outcomes.

insights.title: Best winner rule: ind.ema50_slope_atr <= 0.2183 AND ind.vwap_distance_atr > 5.1432
insights.detail: Decision tree path [ind.ema50_slope_atr <= 0.2183 AND ind.vwap_distance_atr > 5.1432 AND ind.ma_gap_atr > 1.7467 AND ind.rsi_sma > 63.1764] → 13% win rate on 39 trades. vs population 44.3%.

insights.title: High stop-loss rule: ind.clv <= 0.978 AND ind.rsi <= 66.13
insights.detail: Path [ind.clv <= 0.978 AND ind.rsi <= 66.13 AND ind.vwap_distance_atr <= 2.9999 AND ind.donchian_high_20 <= 1.3365] → 22% stop-loss rate on 111 trades.

insights.title: Worst archetype: 'Mixed Quick-Death (S6)' (41% WR)
insights.detail: Cluster 3 (145 trades): WR=41.4%, avg R=-0.11, dominant setup=S6, exit=FAIL_FAST. Top features: score.pullback_quality(z=2.42), score.retrace_depth(z=2.11), state.retrace_depth_atr(z=1.9).

insights.title: Best archetype: 'Winners Target-Hit (S6)' (73% WR)
insights.detail: Cluster 2 (11 trades): WR=72.7%, avg R=0.11, dominant setup=S6, exit=TP1. Top features: ind.bb_ub(z=9.87), ind.kc_ub(z=9.87), ind.ema_50(z=9.87).

insights.title: TP2 hit rate: 5% of profitable exits reach TP2
insights.detail: Of 363 trades exiting at a target, 18 (5%) reached TP2. TP1: 345, TP2: 18.
